title: Fpqc separatedness of the relative Picard sheaf
statement: Let $f:X\to B$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-picard-presheaf] such that $\mathcal O_T\to f_{T,*}\mathcal O_{X_T}$ is an isomorphism for every $T\to B$. The fppf relative Picard sheaf [def-pc-picard-functor] is separated for the fpqc topology [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]: two sections over any $T$ that agree after every arrow of an fpqc covering sieve on $T$ are equal.

source.place: Tags 0D27 (proof, kernel equals image) and 023T; exists_iso_tensorObj_of_toPicardFunctor_app_eq, ratio-cocycle proof generalized from fppf to fpqc

proof.text: Use local surjectivity of the sheafification map to represent the two sections by invertible-module classes L,L-prime on the intersection of their fppf image sieves. This intersection is fppf covering. The sheafification map is fppf-locally injective, hence fpqc-locally injective because fppfTopology is below fpqcTopology. On each member Y of the common representative sieve, pull back the original fpqc sieve. Naturality and the equal restrictions of the two amalgamations make the equalizer sieve of the images of L,L-prime fpqc covering. Local injectivity makes the equalizer sieve of the classes themselves fpqc covering. All assertions here are Mathlib sheafification and sieve lemmas.

Apply fpqc-local equality of Picard classes to L,L-prime on Y to conclude that their images in the relative Picard sheaf agree. The original sections therefore agree over the common representative fppf sieve. Fppf separatedness of the relative Picard sheaf reflects this equality back to T.

proof_origin.place: Agent adaptation of Tags 0D27 and 023T and the existing ratio-cocycle Lean argument
